source: We selected a 2% threshold to balance between maintaining the normality of the Z score distribution while also retaining infrequent but significant mutations in driver genes.
evidence: This is stated directly in Supplemental Text 1.

claim: The TCGA survival analysis is appropriate because the overall survival times of patients within the TCGA is highly consistent with national epidemiological data collected by the NCI.
source: We posit that our survival analysis is appropriate for several reasons. First, we verified that the overall survival times of patients within the TCGA is highly consistent with national epidemiological data collected by the NCI (Figure 1—figure supplement 2D–E).
evidence: This is stated directly in Supplemental Text 2 and supported by Figure 1—figure supplement 2D–E.

claim: Many well-established biomarkers hold prognostic significance in TCGA cohorts, including IDH1 mutations in glioma, TP53 mutations in breast cancer, and tumor stage and grade in multiple cancer types.
source: Secondly, we found that many well-established biomarkers hold prognostic significance in TCGA cohorts, including IDH1 mutations in glioma (Figure 1—figure supplement 7), TP53 mutations in breast cancer (Figure 1—figure supplement 3), tumor stage and grade in multiple cancer types (Figure 2—figure supplement 3), and more.
evidence: This is stated directly in Supplemental Text 2 and supported by multiple figures.

claim: The survival patterns described in the TCGA were validated in several independent patient cohorts.
source: Thirdly, we validated the survival patterns that we describe in the TCGA in several independent patient cohorts, indicating that these are not TCGA-specific phenomena (Figure 4).
evidence: This is stated directly in Supplemental Text 2 and supported by Figure 4.

claim: None of the cohort/endpoint combinations chosen for this study were classified as 'not recommended for use' in an independent analysis of the quality of clinical annotations in the TCGA.
source: Fourthly, in an independent analysis of the quality of clinical annotations in the TCGA (Liu et al., 2018), none of the cohort/endpoint combinations chosen for this study were classified as 'not recommended for use.'
evidence: This is stated directly in Supplemental Text 2 and supported by a citation.

claim: The study builds upon a robust body of work that has also performed survival analyses on TCGA cohorts.
source: Fifthly, our efforts build upon a robust body of work that has also performed survival analyses on TCGA cohorts, and, in some cases, similarly validated findings from the TCGA in independent patient populations (Andor et al., 2016; Davoli et al., 2017; Gentles et al., 2015; Guinney et al., 2015; Uhlen et al., 2017).
evidence: This is stated directly in Supplemental Text 2 and supported by multiple citations.

claim: Patient samples in the TCGA were collected and analyzed in an unbiased manner, precluding the possibility of the 'file-drawer problem' or post-hoc sample size adjustment.
source: Patient samples were collected and analyzed in an unbiased manner, precluding the possibility of the 'file-drawer problem' (failing to publish negative results) or post-hoc sample size adjustment (ending patient enrollment when a significant result is found).
evidence: This is stated directly in Supplemental Text 2.

claim: Significantly more molecular data is available from TCGA tumors than in any other comparably-sized dataset, which allows for multivariate and correlational analyses of different facets of tumor genomes.
source: Significantly more molecular data is available from TCGA tumors than in any other comparably-sized dataset, which allows for multivariate and correlational analyses of different facets of tumor genomes.
evidence: This is stated directly in Supplemental Text 2.

claim: All data from the TCGA and all code from this manuscript are publicly-available, allowing easy replication and extension upon this analysis.
source: All data from the TCGA and all code from this manuscript are publicly-available, allowing easy replication and extension upon this analysis.
evidence: This is stated directly in Supplemental Text 2.
